page.layout: One page of text, single column of verse and epigrams, with faint show-through of the reverse page (ignored). Below the text no notes. No margin notes of the printed page.

main_text.p:
Ingenii, rarâ quod finxit ab arte Prometheus.
Te Pater Æneas, te patruus excitat Hector
Qui Patriæ nati, qui nil nisi celsa volutant.
Olim ubi te matura viris transcripserit ætas,
Sisyphia arx fuerit quando expugnata laborum;
Nî vatem auguriis fallacibus implet Apollo;
Præmia captabis, non ære incisa notisque,
Qualia tempus edax lento consumere tractu
Sæpe solet, sed quæ vires acquirit ab ævo,
Amplior ac duro te fama beabit Ulysse.

Hisce animi sui candorem & officia quæque oppignerat
Joh. Henricus Heideggerus,
S.S.Theol.Stud.Tigur.
main_text.head: IV.
Epigramma.
main_text.p: Nil scit, scire putans se: non, mihi scire videtur.
Scit {bene, male} qui sentit, se {bene male} scire nihil.
Vera / Falsa latent, & {falsa vera} patent: hæc omnia doctus
Illis {non quæstis, haud neglectis, per-} bene doctus eris.
Posuit IOH. RODOLPHUS VVYSSIUS, Theol. Stud.
main_text.head: V.
main_text.p:
Nil mihi cum Phœbo, nil cum permeside lympha,
Nec lauro placuit composuisse comas.
Est labor iste meus, modulanti dicit Apollo:
Hoc solùm cœptis, GRATULOR, addo tuis.
Συγγενείας ἀμβολον ponit HULDRICUS VVYSSIUS, S.Theol.Stud.

page.notes: The Greek in the final signature line is partly illegible; the Epigramma fork diagram was rendered as inline braces. Show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed. Title-level heading "IV." and "V." are numbers set apart; "Epigramma." is a sub-heading.
